method: Keyword enumeration of the PastPerfect public catalog (global /Search covers Object, Photo, Archive, Library, and Container List records). Primary pass: search_criteria=yearbook (82 records). Supplemental passes: 'classbook', 'annual', 'Charlemo'/'Charmelo', and ~60 per-school/district/parish-name queries covering the 52 in-scope St. Charles County seed rows (all run against the same full-text index, capped at 60 results per noisy term). NOTE: the keyword index is not exhaustive of Scope&Content text — the Assumption HS yearbook record (2021.05.16) was found only via the per-school query, not the 'yearbook' query. Advanced Search field-specific queries (Object Name/Title/Description) return no results via plain GET — they may require the site's JS/session flow.
